'''Sehn Baroule''' was the director of [[Premier Provisions]], a small ranch on [[Sprawl 34]] of the planet [[Tyed Kant]]. Secretly he was also a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] agent, operating a hidden listening post to spy on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He died when the [[Mynock virus]] caused the computer systems to go haywire, asphyxiating everyone on Sprawl 34.<ref name="MC" />
